title: Impossible to activate a lowest profil percentage if basal is set to the lowest value (0,05)
symptom: When trying to switch to a lower profile percentage (e.g., 90%) while basal is set to the lowest value (0.05), a popup warning appears saying the basal will be replaced with the minimum allowed value, but after pressing OK, the profile does not change. The issue occurs each time.
cause: The thread suggests it is not an AAPS issue but a pump issue due to hardware/software constraints within pumps. The maintainer agrees that diluted insulin is the only solution for that.
fix: The thread suggests using diluted insulin (e.g., U40) as a workaround, but with strong safety warnings. No direct fix within AAPS is provided.
evidence_quote: I'm afraid it's not an AAPS issue but a pump issue due to hardware/software constraints within pumps (using an APS system or not). Some parents use diluted insulin to workaround this problem
